name: manual_0c17b0
claim: .agent/ root is NOT a drop zone for arbitrary files. The only recognized subdirectories are memory/, skills/, protocols/, tools/. Policy contracts belong in protocols/; lessons must go through learn.py -> graduate.py -> render pipeline into memory/semantic/LESSONS.md — never as a hand-edited .agent/lessons.md at root. Committing files to .agent/ without reading AGENTS.md is the root anti-pattern.

decisions.notes: Caught two stray commits on PT main: .agent/endpoint-policy-contract.yml (should be protocols/) and .agent/lessons.md (bypassed learn.py pipeline entirely, wrong path). Both agents did not read AGENTS.md before writing. 2026-07-04.
